NBA DFS Picks for Friday, November 27 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Friday, November 27 · 7 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 27, 8:46 PM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Friday, November 27 DraftKings main slate at 53.3 DraftKings points for $11,300. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 50.0, $10,000) and Karl-Anthony Towns (NYK, 49.2, $9,600) are next.

Daniss Jenkins (DET) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.08 projected points per $1,000 at $6,600.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 27, 8:46 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
